Definition: a Shaulite or descendant of Shaul
BiblicalUsage: A Shaulite is a descendant of Shaul, the son of Simeon: of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites; of Shaul, the family of the Shaulites, counted in the census of the wilderness.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the families are counted by name because God counts His people house by house, and no family is lost in the number.
